== Summary ==
Group photograph of the players at the [[2015 Rosemount Jedi/Padawan Tournament]], Legion Games, Burnsville, Minnesota, 3 January 2015. Organizer [[Mark Walseth]] posted it with the final standings ("We had 26 Players come today"). The players are not named individually.

* '''Event:''' [[2015 Rosemount Jedi/Padawan Tournament]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2015-01-04

Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=925441#p925441 post 925441] in topic 56802 (First Annual Jedi / Padawan Tournament-Burnsville, MN), by Walsetmd, 2015-01-04. Forum attachment id 4126 (Group Photo.jpg). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123225259/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p925441.html Internet Archive]
